{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid search scope Type 3''' was a detector that aided [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in scanning for traps or other security measures. This version was the most advanced version available, though successful detection depended mostly on the complexity of the device to be detected.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
